does: The main menu's level: walks the loaded modules in load order and returns the MenuLevelName of the last module whose meta.lsx ModuleInfo gives one (empty when none does).

evidence.says: Toolkit GameEngine.dll+0x9943C0 pseudo-code: a loop over the modules (+0x158, count +0x164) keeping the last index with a non-empty ModuleInfo::GetMenuLevel

copy attacks: base game Gustav=SYS_Menuscreen_Act1_A, GustavDev=SYS_Menuscreen_Act3_B (the menu shown); a loose Mods/Gwynerva_Weave/meta.lsx with MenuLevelName SYS_Menuscreen_Act1_A (Weave loads after GustavDev) gave the old beach-cave menu, with no MainMenu timeline at all, and the splash page, the main menu and Continue all worked
GameEngine.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

questions.ask: Where does the dx11 build hold it (inlined into the menu's load?)
